chapter.verse: Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin Jordan gun pan Jesu hong ciah ciangin Kha mah in gamgawtak lak paipih a,
ni sawmli sung dawimangpa' siatzolnaa thuak hi. Tua hun sung teng Jesu in bangmah ne lo ahih manin tua hun a man ciangin gilkial hi.
Dawimangpa in, "Nang Pasian' Tapa na hih takpi leh hih suangtum anlum a suah nadingin gen in," ci hi.
Jesu in, "'Mihing pen anlum bek tawh a nungta hilo hi,' ci-in kigelh hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin dawimangpa in Jesu paipihto-in hun tomno sungin leitung kumpigam khempeuh lak hi.
Tua ciangin dawimangpa in, "Hih uktheihna thu leh amau' minphatna khempeuh kei' tungah hong kipia khinzo a, ka ut peuh pia thei ka hih manin hihte nang kong pia ding hi.
Tua hi a, kei nong biak leh hihte a vekin nangma' a hiding hi," ci hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: "'Topa na Pasian na bia ding a, ama' na bek na sem ding hi,' ci-in kigelh hi."
Tua ciangin dawimangpa in Jerusalem ah Jesu paipihin biakinnpi khumdawn ah dingsak a, "Nang Pasian' Tapa na hihleh hih panin diangsuk in.
A hang pen hih bangin a kigelh om hi: "'Amah in nang' vai-in a vanmite thupia ding a, nang hong cingsak ding hi,'
cih leh, "'Suangtum tungah na khe na tahkhak loh nadingin a khut uh tawh nang hong dom ding uh hi,'"
Jesu in, "'Topa na Pasian na zia-et kei ding hi,' ci-in kigelh hi," ci-in dawngkik hi.
Dawimangpa in a zia-etna teng a man khit ciangin hun lem a omkik ma sung Jesu paikhiatsan hi.
Tua ciangin Kha vangliatna tawh Galilee ah Jesu ciahkik a, a kimkot gam khempeuh ah ama' thu kizel hi.
Vengkhawm innte ah thu hilhcian a, mi khempeuh in amah phat uh hi.
Tua ciangin a khankhiatna Nazareth khua ah Jesu tung hi. Ama' zatngei bangin Sabbath ni-in vengkhawm inn ah pai a, lai a simkhia dingin dingto hi.
Kamsang Isaiah' laihual kipia a, Jesu in laihual a zal leh a nuai-a kigelhna mun tuakkha hi:

"Topa' Kha kei' tungah om hi; a hang pen mizawngte' tungah Lungdamna Thu a tangko dingin amah in kei sathau hong nilh khinzo hi. khuamulote' tungah khuamuhna a ngahkiksak ding, netniam a thuakte a khahkhia ding leh
Topa' maipha ngah kum a tangko dingin amah in kei hong sawl khinzo hi."
A sim khit ciangin Jesu in laihual zialkik a, vengkhawm nasemhuhpa' kiangah piakikin tusuk hi. Vengkhawm inn sunga om mite' mit khempeuh ama' tungah tu hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, "Tuni-in note' zakna-a kisimkhia hih Pasian' Laibu a tangtung hita hi," ci hi.
Mi khempeuh in ama' phatna thu gen uh a, ama' kam pana hong pusuak kammal kilawmte lamdang sa-in, "Hih mipa Joseph' tapa hilo ahi hiam?" ci uh hi.

Jesu in, "Note in 'Zato siampu aw, nanglenang kidamsak dih in!' cih paunak siksanin kei' tungah, 'Capernaum khua-a na bawl ka zakte uh hih na tenna khua ah zong hong bawl dih in,' nong ci ngelngel ding uh hi," ci hi.
A thugen zomin hih bangin ci hi: "Maantak kong cihin ah a pianna khua-a maipha ngah kamsang cih bang om lo hi.
Ahi zongin maantak kong cihin ah Elijah' hun lai-in Israel gam ah meigong tampi om a, himah taleh kum thum-le-lang sung vantungte kikhakin gamsung khempeuh ah kialpi a tun laitak
Sidon gam Zarephath khua-a meigongnu' kiang simloh tua meigongte khat beek' kiangah Elijah kisawl lo hi.
Kamsang Elisha' hun lai-in zong Israel gam ah vun natna vei tampi om himah taleh Syria mi Naaman longal siansuahna a ngah dang kuamah om lo hi."
Hih thute a zak uh ciangin vengkhawm inn sunga om mi khempeuh nakpi-in heh uh hi.
Amaute dingto-in khuasung pan Jesu hawlkhia uh a, kendang ah sawnkhiat dingin khuanawl mualbo kiildawn ah paipih uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute' laizang tawnin Jesu paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee gam khuapi khat ahi Capernaum ah Jesu paisuk a, Sabbath Ni ciangin mite' kiangah thu hilhcian hi.
Thuneihna tawh kam pau ahih manin mite in ama' hilhcianna lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
Vengkhawm inn sungah dawi kihhuai khat ii kha a vei mi khat omin awging lianpi tawh awng a,
"Hei! Nazareth khuami Jesu aw, ko tawh bang kisai na hi hiam? Ko hong susia dinga hong pai na hi hiam? Nang kua cih kong thei hi, Pasian' Mi Siangthopa aw," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu in amah taai a, "Pau kei inla ama' kiangpan pusuak in!" ci hi. Tua ciangin dawi in amaute' laizang ah tua mipa sialpaai a, bangmah liamsuah lo-in a sungpan pusuak hi.
Mite in lamdang sa mahmah uh a, "Hih a kampau, bang ahi hiam? Uktheihna thu leh vangliatna tawh thu a piak ciangin kha ninte pusuak uh hi!" ci-in khatlekhat kiho ngeingai uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua gam kimkot mun citeng ah Jesu' thu kizel hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu dingto a, vengkhawm inn nusia-in Simon' inn ah lut hi. Simon' sungnu cina-in gim mahmah a, amaute in Jesu' huh ding thumsak uh hi.
Cina gei ah Jesu dingin cisa natna a taai leh tua nu zong a cisa kam a, thakhat thu-in thoto-in lengla do pah hi.
Nitum ciangin natna tuamtuam tawh cina khatpeuh a neite khempeuh in a cinate uh hong paipih uh a, Jesu in amaute khat ciat' tungah khut nga-in damsak hi.

Dawite zong mi tampite' sungpan pusuakin kiko uh a, "Nang pen Pasian' Tapa na hi hi!" ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Jesu in dawite taai a, amah Khris ahihlam thei uh ahih manin dawite a pau ding uh phal lo hi.
Zingsang khuavak ciangin Jesu pusuak a, gamlak simtham mun ah pai hi. Mite in amah zong uh a, ama' kiangah pai-in amau' kiangpan a paikhiat loh nadingin kho uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesu in, "Khuadangte ah zong Pasian' kumpigam Lungdamna Thu ka va tangko kul hi. A hang pen tua dingin kei hong kisawl hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judea gam vengkhawm innte ah thu tangko hi.Nungzui A Kiteel Masate
